name: manual_4b9572
claim: A worktree-isolated subagent (Agent isolation: 'worktree') can be stale relative to the live branch if the orchestrating session commits/pushes after the worktree checkout was created — it can then hallucinate a confident, specific-looking-but-false git claim (e.g. 'main already has commit X') instead of expressing uncertainty. Always independently verify any subagent claim about branch/commit state via 'git merge-base --is-ancestor' before trusting it.

decisions.notes: PR #205 quad-CEO-review (2026-07-12): worktree-isolated agent a51e4d78f51585c6b confidently claimed main already carried commit 60636ad5 (the orchestrating session's own just-pushed commit). Verified false via git merge-base --is-ancestor. The agent's underlying strategic reasoning was still partly valid, so the fix is to caveat/correct, not discard the whole review.
